messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER -> metering: Investigating token-count drift + delayed usage emits affecting EU and US regions. Flagging potential false overage alerts. Please ACK in #incidents.

sre-oncall: ACK. I'm up. Looking at the emitter logs now.

maria (billing-eng): saw customer reports of overage emails ~5m ago. Noted increase in 'chargeable_tokens' for some tenants.

jon (support): example customer: acme-inc got 9x spike email at 16:21 UTC. They've pinged CS.

sre-oncall: ok. Initial hypothesis: emit retry storm + duplicate windowing from emitter service after a connection hiccup. Will run quick counts.

kevin (data-ops): running query: SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) FROM token_emits WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY tenant_id; returning a long tail of small duplicates for 120 tenants. sample: acme-inc: 9,120 tokens vs baseline 1,020.

cara (platform): I'm seeing high retry rate from emitter-2 in eu-west-1 from last deploy at 15:58 UTC. logs:
```
emitter-2 WARN retrying message id=abcd123 err=timeout count=4
```

maria (billing-eng): are these duplicates already deduped at the ledger? If not, customers will get overage flags.

kevin (data-ops): dedupe window is 10s but many retries had slightly different envelope ids due to proxy rewrite, so dedupe missed them.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause automated overage-notify job 2) enable emitter fallback (route to emitter-1) 3) run idempotency patch to normalize envelope ids 4) run scrub job to collapse duplicate emits before ledger commit. Who can flip notify?

maria (billing-eng): I can pause notify quickly. Doing: `POST /admin/flags/overage-notify/_pause` -> response 202.

jon (support): paused. Notifying CS to stop escalation to customers. Sending templated hold message now.

cara (platform): routing rule in progress: redirect emitter-2 traffic to emitter-1. Command:
```
kubectl patch svc/emitter-svc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"emitter":"emitter-1"}}}'
```
Applying... done.

sre-oncall: good. I also pushed idempotency normalization to emitter staging; going to hotfix to prod now. small change: normalize-envelope-id = sha256(src_id + timestamp \| 1s-floor).

kevin (data-ops): starting scrub job to detect duplicate groups and emit collapsed delta. Query used:
```
WITH recent AS (SELECT envelope_hash, count(*) as c, sum(tokens) as t FROM raw_emits WHERE ts > now()-'1 hour' GROUP BY envelope_hash)
SELECT * FROM recent WHERE c > 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Found ~1.2M duplicate rows across 3,200 envelopes.

maria (billing-eng): that's a big number. How long to scrub/backfill?

kevin (data-ops): running parallel jobs by shard, ETA ~45m to generate backfill deltas; 10m more to apply to ledger with rate-limited writes.

sre-oncall: timeline sounds ok. We left overage notifications paused. Any customer-impact other than false overages (e.g., quota enforcement)?

maria (billing-eng): quota enforcement runs later. For now only email flags triggered; we prevented automatic billing changes. We should still check for throttles.

cara (platform): emitter-1 routing stabilized, retries down to baseline. Observability: emitter retry-rate graph dropping back to normal at 16:34 UTC.

jon (support): CS updated customers: "we are investigating false overage alerts; please ignore emails until further notice." Some customers asked for invoice hold - we can offer credit if charges applied. Need exec approval later.

sre-oncall: ok. action items:
- maria: keep notifies paused until we confirm ledger scrub applied. (owner)
- kevin: finish backfill -> signal here with summary. (owner)
- cara: monitor emitter fleet + revert routing when safe. (owner)
- jon: coordinate CS comms and collect impacted tenant list. (owner)

maria (billing-eng): noted. I'll not resume until kevin confirms no duplicates in ledger for affected window.

kevin (data-ops): backfill delta job complete. Summary: collapsed 1.2M duplicate rows into net +89k tokens (original spike was +1.1M). Applied to ledger at 17:15 UTC with rate limiting. Post-apply check shows token tallies for top 10 affected tenants back to within 5% of baseline.

sre-oncall: excellent. any lingering alerts?

cara (platform): emitter metrics green. no more retry storm. I will revert routing to normal at 17:25 UTC.

maria (billing-eng): resuming overage notifications in 15m after final verification run. If any tenant still flagged incorrectly we'll do manual credits.

jon (support): CS notified customers that issue resolved and credits will be handled case-by-case. they asked for timeline details; I linked this thread.

kevin (data-ops): final verification query shows no duplicate envelope_hash >1 beyond 17:10 UTC window. all clear.

sre-oncall: handing off to night oncall (kevin) with summary: root cause - emitter retry + proxy envelope rewrite -> dedupe missed -> duplicates reached ledger; mitigation - paused notifications, rerouted emitter, applied idempotency normalization, scrubbed duplicates, backfilled ledger, resumed operations. If anything crops up ping me or page SRE P0.

kevin (data-ops): ACK. I'll watch the metrics and keep CS updated if any outliers appear. Logging this in incident tracker: INC-178555. Closing pager.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT INC-178555 status -> resolved (postmortem pending). :white_check_mark:
